HOLD-001.proofSource:
import Mathlib
example (a b c : Nat) : a + (b + c) = b + (a + c) := by simpa using Nat.add_left_comm a b c

HOLD-002.proofSource:
import Mathlib
example (a b c : Nat) : a * (b * c) = b * (a * c) := by simpa using Nat.mul_left_comm a b c

HOLD-003.proofSource:
import Mathlib
example (p : Prop) : (p ↔ p) := by simpa using iff_self p

HOLD-004.proofSource:
import Mathlib
example {α β} (f : α → β) : f ∘ id = f := by simpa using Function.comp_id f

HOLD-005.proofSource:
import Mathlib
example {α} (s t : Set α) : s ∪ t = t ∪ s := by simpa using Set.union_comm s t

HOLD-006.proofSource:
import Mathlib
example (a b : Nat) : max a b = max b a := by simpa using max_comm a b
